statusText: Mapped policy state: green / EA_ON. NQ is closed for the weekend, so no persistent one-way price path is currently observable.
recommendation: Tail remains below the watch threshold; weekend geopolitical and energy developments remain the principal conditional reopening risks.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress during the closed weekend session
body: Friday ended with Nasdaq gains led by semiconductors despite negative breadth, while Treasury yields were above 5% and crude remained above $100. Saudi supply disruption and fresh security alerts add weekend gap uncertainty, but without live NQ price discovery they do not establish persistent mean-reversion failure.
